notes.title: Patch 0.4.0 is now avalible!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1][p][b]Patch 4 is here![/b] We’ve reworked health, stamina, and armor into sleek new bars, rebalanced early-game zombies to be less punishing, and added long-requested features like a [b]continue button[/b], [b]day counter[/b], and crafting got a serious upgrade with categories and resource descriptions. And! [b]Artillery now makes its grand entrance early in the game.[/b][/p][p] On top of that, we tackled a huge list of bugs: [b]fixed infinite loadings, improved collisions, polished UI, rebalanced weapons, cleaned up co-op desyncs, and patched countless PoI softlocks.[/b] Oh, and [b]we killed off that big FPS drop when loading new parts of the world[/b] — your frames can finally breathe.
[/p][h3]More balance, more customization, smoother performance — welcome to Patch 4![/h3][p][/p][h3]🛡️ [b]Health, Stamina & Armor Bars[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The old icons retired and bars moved in. This gives us way more control over balancing — especially in the early game — and makes your survival stats easier to read at a glance.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧟 [b]Zombie Balancing[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Early-game zombies are now less “[i]oops, you’re dead[/i]” and more “[i]heck yeah, I got this![/i]” Still dangerous, but way more fun to take down.[/p][/*][/list][h3]▶️ [b]Continue Button in Main Menu[/b][/h3][list][*][p]One button. One click. Back in the game. Simple, clean, finally here.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🛠️ [b]Custom Mode Upgrades[/b][/h3][p]More knobs and sliders to twist! You can now adjust:[/p][list][*][p]Zombie health[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie damage[/p][/*][*][p]Player damage [/p][/*][*][p]Resource gathering amount [/p][/*][*][p]Day/night cycle length [/p][/*][*][p]Increased zombie amount in the world[/p][/*][*][p]No roadblocks [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f6a7.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]No night attacks [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f319.png"][/img] ([i]now a checkbox, no more hiding in settings[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]All blueprints unlocked [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4d8.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Free building mode [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f3d7-fe0f.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]💣 [b]Artillery in Early Game[/b][/h3][list][*][p] We smoothed out the early-game flow so you get a taste of big booms right away. [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f4a5.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]🔔 [b]Interaction Notifications[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Small star effects now pop up when you interact with things — a little sparkle never hurts [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/2728.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]⏳ [b]Day Counter[/b][/h3][list][*][p] You can now see what day you’re on, right next to the clock. Survival journaling just got easier.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧰 [b]Crafting Menu Overhaul[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Materials now have descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]Each description includes where to find them[/p][/*][*][p]Recipes are organized into categories ([i]no more endless scrolling![/i])[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚙️ [b]Machine Collision Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We improved collision so it’s [b]much[/b] harder to trap yourself inside machines. Freedom restored.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🚀 [b]Optimization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Removed a nasty FPS drop when loading new parts of the world. Your frames are safe again! [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f680.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]📈 Fixes & Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed trees and grids not loading Thanks also to everyone who used our Bug Reporter, which helped us quickly track down and squash the bugs that were hurting your gameplay experience! [/p][p]We haven’t said our last word yet, but these fixes should significantly improve your time with Survival Machine! Once again, thank you for being with us![/p][p][url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]Come join us on our Discord[/url], where you can always meet someone from the dev team and chat about the game![/p][p]See you next time!

notes.title: Content Preview - Meet the Zombieburg!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello Survivors![/h1][p]You already know quite a lot about the upcoming Alpine Biome, but so far I haven’t mentioned a single word about the gameplay novelties we’re preparing for you. With this post I’d like to change that. Let me introduce you to Doctor Zombiestein and his flying fortress Zombieburg.[/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/5b9cf63d669e9308a3ee2c309808fb25906be3e0.gif"][/img][/p][p]I’d like to tell you the story of Zombiestein a little later – we’ll still have some time for that – but for now I want to show you the results of the last few weeks of work. Let’s go![/p][h2]1.Introduction to Zombieburg[/h2][p]The powerful mobile fortress of Zombiestein not only flies, but also shoots! Be careful, because although at first glance Zombieburg may look slow and clumsy, don’t be fooled by appearances! Zombiestein, a brilliant though slightly mad scientist, has prepared well for a possible encounter with Survivors![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/456c1a4e1dd748c435b9598080db49b9186a934b.gif"][/img][/p][p]His machine is equipped with the latest technological marvels. It even has a rocket engine that gives it unprecedented speed, and it is armed with powerful cannons capable of easily sweeping away everything you’ve been so carefully building on the Machine.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/ce39816a1cbde0b145ed90be5b75d46b5a073e03.gif"][/img][/p][p]Zombieburg hunts both during the day and at night, and it’s very hard to hide from it. Nothing is able to conceal you from its sight, and when a shadow suddenly covers the sun or the moon, look up at the sky and get ready to fight![/p][p]And how to fight it? Defensive turrets will definitely come in handy – they will be your main weapon against Zombieburg, although you can also damage it using ranged handheld weapons. It’s certainly not as effective as cannons, but every reasonable Survivor will fire at the incoming monster with whatever they’ve got![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/9ae23e4aafbe9ef0ac65acf23e4d74b8d05b3103.gif"][/img][/p][p]Fortunately, Zombieburg is not indestructible, but even when damaged it still has a few tricks up its sleeve. For now, I won’t reveal anything more 🙂[/p][p]One last thing: [b]we plan to adjust Zombieburg and the difficulty of the fight to the number of players in the session.[/b] Solo players will face a slightly easier challenge than a team of four Survivors. But I’ll tell you more about that in detail in my next post![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/80aff4fad02a158cea09efa73d79807be9575559.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]2. Wrap up![/h2][p]Zombieburg is not available in the game yet, but we can’t wait for you to encounter Zombiestein and his airborne vehicle for the first time. We’ve already run some short tests and it looks very promising, but you’ll unfortunately have to wait a bit longer for more details.[/p][p]But even now I can ask you – what else should such a massive zombie airship be able to do? I’d love to hear your ideas here in the comments or on [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]our Discord[/url], to which I warmly invite you![/p][p]Thanks for being with us, Survivors![/p][p]See you soon!
Berdol[/p][p]

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 is live!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Survivors![/h1][p]
[h2]🎉 Our first Major Update is now live on Steam![/h2]

This marks another big milestone for us — and for you, it means a whole lot of fixes and improvements across the board!
We’ve touched on many aspects of the game, including further optimization tweaks, full gamepad support, the ability to change the UI keybinds, and of course... [b]the long-promised Tommy Gun![/b]

So what exactly is changing in Survival Machine starting today? Check out the full patch notes below! 👇
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌟 Major Additions[/h3] [list][*] 📌 Improved early quest flow to visit a POI (Points of Interest) earlier.
[*] 🏗️ Changed costs on building elements to be more accessible.
[*]  🔒 Building menu will now show locked items.
[*]  🎮 Added full-gamepad support. [b]We reached GOLD![/b]
[*]  🎀 Added multiple nice decorations to build. Decorations now provide additional storage space on the Machine.
[*]  🔫 Added Tommy Gun, can be found in legendary chests after mid-game phase.
[*]  🖱️ Players can now change UI keybinds
[*]  🚀 Major optimization improvements
[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]🧱 Collision & Environment Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Several cockpit assets (chairs, tables, railings, floors) have corrected collisions.
[*]  Walls can now be used for hanging objects on both sides without restrictions.
[*]  Corrected lack of collision on Factory platforms and Windmill platforms.
[*]  Fixed areas where players could fall through the map in Cemetery Medium and Oil Rig Easy.
[*]  Resolved issues with objects and terrain causing players to get stuck under or inside geometry.
[*]  Removed invisible collision barriers blocking player interaction at multiple POIs (Points of Interest).[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Functional Fixes[/h3]
[list][*]  Fixed bug preventing players from starting a new game using Game Pad.
[*]  Players can place two roofs adjacent to each other where previously restricted.
[*]  Fixed active reload mechanic failing to work properly in co-op mode.
[*]  Addressed crafting bugs where clicking "Craft 5" would craft only once, and crafting would trigger outside valid UI bounds.
[*]  Fixed weapon shooting freeze and hotbar locking issues.
[*]  Fixed player getting stuck on ladders, platforms, and drivable vehicles.
[*]  Corrected issue where players could open certain chests from invalid positions or from underneath.
[*]  Resolved players stuck in the permanent options menu if the menu was open at death.
[*]  Fixed quest progression bugs including “destroy the zombie fort” marker visibility and “move the Machine” quest not completing.
[*]  Corrected issue where blueprints and autosaves overlapped causing game freezes.
[*]  Fixed problems with multiplayer hot join and item duplication blocking inventory and building[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🖼️ Visual & UI Fixes[/h3] 
[list][*] Added proper glowing effects on all buildable objects.
[*]  Fixed misplaced UI elements such as task UI overlapping inventory UI and shifted build UI arrows.
[*]  Fixed language switching updating button labels correctly.
[*]  Added options to turn off automatic saves and improved control mapping responsiveness.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🚀 Performance & Stability[/h3]
[list][*]  Eliminated infinite loading screens on multiple save states.
[*]  Resolved crashes caused by overlapping autosave events and corrupted player files.
[*]  Fixed softlock issues on Factory and Oil Rig levels.
[*]  Corrected rotation and spawn position bugs on Oil Rig platforms.
[*]  Improved machine building synchronization between clients in multiplayer.
[*]  Fixed player model disappearing during skin changes at stations.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🌐 Localization & Accessibility[/h3]
[list][*] Corrected Polish translation errors (e.g., “kick” action).
[*]  Fixed several scattered UI text fragments in Japanese and Traditional Chinese.
[*]  Updated accessibility features including keybind changes and controller sensitivity splitting.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]🧩 Miscellaneous[/h3][p] Removed offensive NPC name to respect all players.
 [list][*] Added day counter to the game HUD.
[*]  Fixed various POI-related bugs including hidden or invisible levers and disabled zipline usage after updates.
[*]  Improved build menu usability.
[*]  Fixed bugs where dropped items on machines were uninteractive.
[*]  Adjusted environment LOD transitions to prevent aggressive quality changes.
[*]  Fixed problems with quest task display on older save files.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
[h3]👋 As always, we’re looking forward to hearing your feedback after the update![/h3]
We’ve done our best to make sure everything works as it should, but if you run into any issues or bugs, please let us know — either on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url] or right here in the comments below. 

[b]Oh, and the bug reporter - use it in any case![/b] Don’t forget to write a few words about the issue you’re having in the text area - it helps us understand and find the bug much, much quicker! 

Thank you for being with us — your support and activity mean the world to the team!

[b]Have a great weekend, Survivors! [/b]
Dzięki 
Berdol

notes.title: Update 0.3.0 – All You Need to Know!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Survivors! [/h1][p]Today, I’d like to give you a little sneak peek of what we’ve been working on for Update 0.3.0, launching in just a week![/p][p]As always, we’ve put a lot of love and effort into this update, and we can’t wait to hear what you think about the new improvements coming to Survival Machine. Here's a quick look at what we've been up to in the past few weeks:[/p][list][*][p][b]🔧 Optimization – [/b]smoother and more stable gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🔫 Tommy Gun –[/b] a brand new weapon is coming your way! [/p][/*][*][p][b]🏗️  Building System – [/b]faster, more precise, and with new possibilities![/p][/*][*][p][b] 🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim – [/b]play your way, with enhanced aiming support[/p][/*][*][p][b] 🖱️  Customizable Controls in UI –  [/b]full key rebind options![/p][/*][/list][h2]
🔧 Optimization[/h2][p]We know this has been one of our bigger pain points, but also one of our top priorities. With the release of Update 0.3.0, you should notice a significant improvement in this area — we’ve put a lot of effort into it![/p][p]Alongside several smaller and larger changes, there’s one worth highlighting: starting with Update 0.3.0 , [b]the game will automatically suggest settings tailored to your PC’s capabilities[/b]. Of course, you're still free to manually adjust these settings if you prefer.[/p][p]However, we can’t move forward without you — we need your feedback on any issues you encounter. Update 0.3.0  definitely doesn’t mark the end of our optimization efforts, and the more input we get from you, the faster and more accurately we can keep improving![/p][p][/p][h2][b]🔫 [/b]Tommy Gun[/h2][p][b]We made a promise? We sure did! And now we’re delivering![/b][/p][p]A weapon ahead of its time — the pinnacle of military technology — is waiting for you just around the corner. A 20-round magazine and incredible rate of fire make it the perfect tool for taking on larger hordes of zombies. Few will be able to break through the wall of lead that Tommy unleashes.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/09bcaa6e9ca272f1bb110e38050122a1de9f8467.png"][/img][i]Pew pew pew pew!![/i][/p][p][b]You won’t be able to craft Tommy yourself at one of our workshops[/b] — to wield it, you’ll have to leave the safety of the Machine and head out to explore the world. Somewhere out there, hidden in one of the scattered crates, Tommy is waiting to be found.[/p][p]But fair warning — don’t go looking for Tommy right at the start of the game. We’ve planned for it to appear a bit later, as you progress through your journey.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🏗️ Building System[/b][/h2][p]We had to take a step back and rethink the direction we want to take when it comes to building in our game. I'm talking about the vibe we want you to feel when constructing new structures and decorating your homes.[/p][p]It feels like it’s time to give this aspect a clearer, more defined direction — and that’s exactly what the upcoming changes in Update 0.3.0  aim to deliver.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/c0ce51c965ed09ed9e1058617cc3d96f67d170a7.png"][/img][i]Let there be light![/i][/p][h3]Decorations will be getting a theme[/h3][p]Survival Machine is all about the journey the player takes alongside their Machine. We wanted that theme to be reflected in our building system as well. That’s why we’re aiming for the new decorations to capture that same atmosphere.[/p][p]Our idea? Something along the lines of a traveler’s living workshop. What do you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/404ad554421e4e0b3d53a60081d82ccd674d88ab.png"][/img][i]The number of pipes needed to keep the Machine running is measured in miles — sometimes they even spill out from the deck![/i][/p][p]We want our decorative elements to fit well with the theme of the road that runs through our game. That’s why you’ll find trophies you’ve earned along the way, reminders of your journey.[/p][p]We also want to showcase the last remnants of luxury items humanity managed to create before the zombie apocalypse. And of course, there’ll be countless bits and pieces every traveler carries — things collected along the way that [i]might[/i] come in handy... someday.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/990f362b0ce7f9b38f747408f6f6c1331949b258.png"][/img][i]Your very own botanical garden[/i][/p][h3]Changes to the models[/h3][p]In addition to new features, we’ll also be making several improvements to things you’re already seeing in [i]Survival Machine[/i]. We’ve started reworking some of the models to better match the vibe I mentioned earlier. I won’t reveal all the details just yet, but take a look at the bed, for example. Before the changes, it looked like this:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/013fb888af242928439d005a0a930057afdd7761.png"][/img][/p][p]And after the changes, we’re proposing this look:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/1444f81d72cbf3b08bdf3fb7105d96dd515073ab.png"][/img][/p][p]What do you think?[/p][h3]Decorations increase storage[/h3][p]No, of course not all decorations will increase the item storage limit on the Machine. However, we felt that what currently serves as storage isn't sufficient — and not entirely logical either. After all, a wardrobe should have that function too, don’t you think?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/933f909656b53f64d3d07f95036b97cca5199412.png"][/img][i]No, the new wall clock won't increase your storage limit, but it looks pretty cool![/i][/p][h3]Building will be cheaper, and decorating less complicated![/h3][p]A lot of feedback was focused on this aspect. You mentioned that sometimes you don’t feel like hunting down recipes for decorations. We understand that, and we’d like to propose some changes here: while some of the best and most interesting decorative elements will still require finding recipes (so it doesn’t get too easy), we’ve significantly simplified the decoration process for your Machine.[/p][p]This way, everyone can quickly create a beast they can identify with, and more importantly — one that they enjoy building and traveling with to the last bastion of humanity.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🎮 Gamepad Support & Auto-Aim[/b][/h2][p]In the previous update, we introduced the beta support for controllers. Based on your feedback, it seems that this control method is working well, and we haven’t received any major issues from you regarding its performance. And that’s great! [/p][p][b]With Update 0.3.0, we want to introduce an additional feature — auto-aim.[/b] Once again, just like with the controller support, we kindly ask for your feedback. Let us know how you think the auto-aim is working and where there’s room for improvement.[/p][p][b]Important note:[/b] if you’re not a fan of this feature, you can always turn it off by selecting the appropriate option in the settings.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]🖱️ Customizable Controls in UI [/b][/h2][p]Another important feature that many of you, especially left-handed players, have mentioned. With next week's patch, you will gain the ability to customize your key bindings to suit your individual needs. We hope this change will make your gaming experience more comfortable![/p][p]However, if any issues arise, please make sure to let us know — whether it's in the comments on Steam under this post or by [url="https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8"]reaching out to us on our Discord[/url].[/p][p]We’d like to ask you to share your feedback on what accessibility options you think we should add. We’re aware that some players may have disabilities, so your input will be valuable in making the game more inclusive for everyone![/p][p][/p][h2]📦 [b]Wrap-Up[/b][/h2][p]That’s all for the sneak peek at [b]next week’s Update 0.3.0[/b]! We hope the changes we’re making will make the game more enjoyable for you. As always, we’re counting on your feedback – it means a lot to us![/p][p]Thanks for being with us, and we hope you have many fun and exciting evenings ahead with Survival Machine.[/p][p]Until next time! Dzięki![/p][p]Berdol

notes.title: Discover the Alpine Biome!
notes.content:
[h2]Hi Survivors, [/h2][p]I’m Dawid, and I’m a level designer at Survival Machine. Before I get to the point, let me say a few words about myself. I studied Computer Science in Wrocław where I also began my journey in game development. Besides creating games, I’m passionate about football and major events like the Euro and the World Cup. My second passion is cars — I absolutely love sports cars! On warm days, I enjoy going on bike trips, and in the evenings, I often spend time playing with my chinchilla, Nela. [/p][p]Today, I’d like to take you on a short trip to the snowy mountains and show you a bit of the world we’re preparing for you.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/b2f0d4185aa33aa4cfdde99ee638e74e74a00276.png"][/img][/p][p]As you already know from Berdol's previous posts and our roadmap, we’re working hard on the next biome — the inaccessible and freezing Alpine. There’s still quite a bit of creative work ahead of us, but I’d already like to share the first results of what we’ve done so far.[/p][h3]What will Alpine be like?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/4e4576e2c4feb5097b775d45038393b2cd01a502.png"][/img][/p][p]Life in the mountainous Alpine was not easy. Harsh weather and steep cliffs posed significant challenges for the local community involved in logging. And not just any wood, but the enormous sequoias that, thanks to the unique microclimate, grow in the alpine valleys. It was here that mountain streams would merge into a river, and the wood was then floated down to the nearby port, where cargo ships awaited loading. Unfortunately, one of these ships was in the port when a rockslide completely blocked the shipping channel, cutting the ship off from the open sea, trapping it there forever.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/a877ad3f7536031204380a759258ab08fa160b45.png"][/img][/p][p]Alpine will be quite different from Frontier, which you’re already very familiar with. While Frontier offers open spaces that are relatively easy to travel through, in Alpine, you’ll need to prepare for a lot more challenges. Canyons, valleys, towering peaks, and hidden caves won’t just treat you to stunning scenery — they’ll also be perfect places fo me to conceal secrets and stash loot crates. I encourage you to dive deep into our winter world, where exploration brings not only excitement and spectacular views, but also meaningful rewards for your dedication.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/a5dcd21df918648724250710cdc846f37443f1e8.png"][/img][/p][p]I’ve seen a lot of positive feedback about our PoIs, and when designing new puzzles and challenges for the Alpine Biome, I’d like to expand on the ideas from Frontier that you enjoyed the most.[/p][p]In the Alpine Biome, we want to challenge our Survivors. So, I’m preparing plenty of climbing and parkour elements for you. So far, in Frontier, you've mostly moved horizontally, but the Alpine biome will add vertical elements to the mix. What does that mean for you? Paragliding and zip lines scattered across the world will become your best friends when exploring this biome.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/77e76253a968c673bb789700515ce50bded6d6a2.png"][/img][/p][p]But! We won’t be relying solely on platforming elements; I’m also preparing various kinds of puzzles for you. Like the ones you'll encounter at our first roadblock, the bridge.  [/p][h3]Frozen bridge  [/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/3cf0d60129029b32a4df553f2ea593296d921256.png"][/img][/p][p]The heavy drawbridge is one of the most important infrastructure elements in the Alpine biome. It allowed massive machines to cross over the river, which served as a transport corridor for the floating timber. Today, after the apocalypse, its mechanisms are neglected and frozen. The Survivors' task will be to unlock the bridge mechanisms and enable our Machine to continue its journey.  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/f61f74bae6d2c73cb66bb1e4d0082dabad99238c.png"][/img][/p][p]To do this, you’ll need to activate special lights that were once used to thaw the bridge’s mechanisms. For the lights to work, they need to be powered. Unfortunately, the nearby power plant has long since stopped working, the passage to it is blocked, and the local power relays are damaged. [/p][p]I can assure you, it won’t be easy. I’m preparing several small challenges related to this roadblock for you. You’ll need dynamite and a sharp eye, but we’ll also test your memory with a code-entry challenge. But I’m giving away too much already — wait for the final result!

notes.title: Patch 0.2.0 is now available!
notes.content: [h1][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/h1][p]Here comes Patch 0.2.0, which we’ve been working on over the past few weeks. It’s the result of your feedback and the needs you’ve so actively expressed in your reviews, discussions, and conversations on Discord. Thank you so much for your support and help with Survival Machine – without you, this patch wouldn’t be nearly as extensive! I hope the changes we’ve introduced will have a significant impact on how you experience Survival Machine and increase the enjoyment we want you to get from playing it. That’s enough of an introduction – let’s get into the details![/p][hr][/hr][h2]🚀 Highlights[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game-pad Support (Beta)[/b] - First iteration of game-pad support is live! Check the dedicated controller tab in Settings (we show Xbox tool-tips) and tell us how it feels. Auto-aim is planned for a future update.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Machine Collision Overhaul[/b] - Re-authored cockpit, ladder, pallet, front bumper, and railing colliders; prevents falling through, window-vaulting, and “air-walking” across the machine.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Crash & Infinite-Load Fixes[/b] - Addressed the top-reported crashes and added an on-screen message for rare infinite-load cases.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Performance Pass[/b] - Smarter render-distance swaps on quality presets, trimmed loading times, memory spikes, and GPU stalls on Low settings[/p][/*][*][p][b]Night Loot[/b] - Zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults, rewarding after-dark defence.[/p][/*][*][p][b]No Hard Game-Over[/b] - New Game-Lost flow: the night ends if all core components are destroyed—players must repair them before the machine can move on, but you can’t lose anymore.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Weakpoint Visuals[/b] - Destroyed weakpoints now switch to a broken model for clearer feedback and less confusion.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Music Blend[/b] - Re-tuned soundtrack logic for smoother transitions between Default, Combat, and POI themes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Siege Frequency Balance[/b] - On Adventure & Survival difficulties, zombie siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][*][p][b]POI Variety Boost[/b] - New randomisation rules greatly reduce how often the same POI appears in a single run.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Detailed Patch Notes[/h2][hr][/hr][h3]🎮 Controls[/h3][list][*][p]Added full gamepad support with separate Xbox icons (beta). In the automatic setting, the game will detect whether you're using a gamepad or a mouse and keyboard. We've also left the option to choose mouse and keyboard only.[/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//40709796/4cf779fa6400379eb2d65e6d8b4295b16df97e84.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare input lock when spamming ESC in the key-bind window while confirming changes.[/p][/*][*][p]“Load Game” now highlights the most recent save, not the oldest.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🏗️ Machine & Level Geometry[/h3][list][*][p]Cockpit interior, windows, and front plate now block players correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Patched gaps in ladders, railings, furnace walkway, bridge, and several POIs—no more sneaking into the void.[/p][/*][*][p]Wheels no longer spin in place after the Machine stops at a blockage.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed watermark plank collision on the bridge; fixed floating barrel after green dynamite[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🌍 World, Quests & Interaction[/h3][list][*][p]New games always start on the Stream map before rolling into random order as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Zip-line: fixed an issue you drop early from the zip-line![/p][/*][*][p]Quest markers now clear correctly once the gate quest is finished.[/p][/*][*][p]“Player is full” tooltip shows only when you try to eat.[/p][/*][*][p]Added item sort-by-category and made Drop/Take-All respect that filter.[/p][/*][*][p]Weakpoints now swap to a destroyed mesh once broken.[/p][/*][*][p]Implemented new PoI randomization rules so locations repeat far less often.[/p][/*][*][p]Night Loot: zombies now drop loot during nightly assaults.[/p][/*][*][p]Game-Lost rework: the night ends if all core components are destroyed; players must repair them before the machine can move on—total game-over is gone.[/p][/*][*][p]Polish to the repair UI and new construction VFX.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🧟 AI & Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Zombies no longer spawn or run mid-air; levitating hordes grounded.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed zombie pathing that let them climb machine ladders or breach secret gates unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Zombie names are now synchronized for all players![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed issue where zombies could stop reacting to players after extended sessions.[/p][/*][*][p]Balanced pursuit logic—zombies no longer chase forever once line-of-sight is broken.[/p][/*][*][p]On Easy and Medium difficulties, siege nights now occur every three nights by default.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📦 Multiplayer & Saves[/h3][list][*][p]Autosave stability greatly improved; fixed client inventory loss and wrong character loading. Let us know if the issue still persists![/p][/*][*][p]Lobby: Invite-Friend button now updates when privacy changes; Steam Overlay no longer appears in SP lobby.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed rare case where the client would spawn inside the starter house when loading a host-only save that skipped the tutorial.[/p][/*][*][p]Resolved bug causing missing quests, workbenches, or upgrades after loading certain saves.[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed inventory lock that could occur when opening chests simultaneously in co-op.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🎨 Graphics & Audio[/h3][list][*][p]Restored missing textures in tunnels (Low) and on the optimization build.[/p][/*][*][p]Structures now play hit sounds when struck by zombies.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed assorted clipping banners, drapes, grass, and roof pieces.[/p][/*][*][p]Music blend improved – smoother transitions between combat and POI themes.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]⚙️ Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]Quality-preset swaps now override render distance properly.[/p][/*][*][p]General CPU/GPU tuning, fewer hitch-up spikes, faster level streaming.[/p][/*][*][p]Tackled heavy frame drops in co-op[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🛠️ Crash & Stability[/h3][list][*][p]Resolved several crash reports.[/p][/*][*][p]Added back-end protections around heavy-attack, zip-line use, and autosave triggers.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐛 Bugs[/h3][list][*][p]We squashed 200 + issues across UI, AI, audio, animation, collision, and quest logic. If you still encounter a problem, [b]drop a report or screenshot[/b]—your findings help us keep Survival Machine rock-solid.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h2]Known Issues & Call for Feedback[/h2][list][*][p][b]Game-pad support is brand new, still a beta —tell us if a button feels off or a glyph is missing.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]We rebuilt dozens of colliders; if you still find spots to clip out of bounds, drop a screenshot in 🐛・bug-report on our Discord or use the in-game Bug Reporter tool (F2).[/p][/*][*][p]If crashes or infinite loads persist, send the in-game report or ping us on Discord with your log[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks for surviving with us—see you on the rails! 👷‍♀️🛠️ Dzięki[/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com//store_item_assets/steam/apps/1601330/header.jpg?t=1747221225"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Sneak Peak: Rewards for zombie night attacks are coming!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Survivors![/h2]
Today, I’d like to share a bit more about the reward system we’re working on for surviving the nightly zombie attacks. Many of you have mentioned it in your messages, comments, and reviews — and we hear you loud and clear. You want changes, and changes are coming! This post will explain how we plan to make it all work.

[h3]The Reward System[/h3]
For now, our nighttime zombies don't leave any gravestones on the Machine. Not to mention any loot. But after the upcoming update, every nightly zombie attack will become an opportunity to earn rewards!

The reward system is being designed to scale  not only with your progress in the game but also to the number of players in the session. The further you are, the better the loot you’ll be able to find! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/52589cdb82126033df0ac184d8ee67c1fb79849e.png[/img]

[b]The gravestones are a key part of this system.[/b] Selected zombies will leave behind gravestones – and that’s where you’ll find your rewards. What can you expect to get? Materials, resources, weapons, and tools.

How you divide the loot among yourselves is entirely up to you. Will one of you grab all the best stuff, or will you share everything equally? That’s your call, Survivors! 

Now you’re probably wondering – when will the update be available? I'I can’t promise a specific date, but we’re working hard and expect it to be ready quite soon! If you have any questions about how our reward system will work, you can always find me here in the comments or on our Discord – [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]which I warmly invite you to join[/url]! Take care Survivors!

notes.content:
[h1]Hi Survivors, welcome to Custom Mode![/h1]

[b]Yes, you heard that right – custom mode![/b] Starting today, every Survival Machine player will be able to tailor the gameplay to their own preferences. Decide how often and in what numbers zombies will attack your Machine at night. Adjust the number of zombies in our Points of Interest, or take control over the durability of your items! [b]You can find Custom Mode when you start or load a game in the lobby![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/463cb428a7a74bd264a8cc48c8bd12c3f3abc4ce.png[/img]
What exactly are you going be able to change? We have few options for you:
[list][*] [b]Days Between Zombie Attacks[/b] – Survivors can now choose how often zombie attacks occur: every day, every 2, 3. 4 or 5 days, [b]or not at all[/b]. The decision is yours! 
[*] [b]Zombie attacks size during the night[/b] - the night attack is too easy? Try 200%! You want the game to be a bit less challanging? 50% is an option for you!
[*] [b]Points of Interest Zombie Count[/b] - change the number of zombies you'll encounter at our Festival, Caravan Crash and Tent Camp point of interest
[*] [b]Core Components Damage Over Time[/b] - you decide whether the core components of the Machine will degrade over time or not at all
[*] [b]Machine Fuel Usage Multiplier[/b] -  take control of fuel consumption! Increase the multiplier to make the game more challenging with higher fuel usage, or lower it for a more forgiving experience.
[*] [b]Item Durability Loss[/b] - this was something you highlighted often in your feedback. We're now putting the durability system in your hands—tweak it, reduce it, or turn it off entirely![/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/0856bc4c4d23386cca254b46665d8ae3bb0275bf.png[/img]
We hope this update significantly improves your gameplay experience – from now on, you decide how the core mechanics work! Big thanks to everyone for your feedback and for pointing out the issues that mattered to you. Let us know what you think!

This isn’t the end of improvements in Survival Machine – what else would you like to see in custom mode? Is there a feature you didn’t find on our list but think is really important? Let us know in the comments or on [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]our Discord[/url]! Thanks! See you soon!

notes.content:
[h1]And... we're live Survivors! [/h1]

[previewyoutube=9R6oLmjsMkM;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Steam Next Fest kicks off today, and with it, our coop Demo, which you can already download to your PCs![/b] We're giving you access to a substantial part of our world, several Points of Interest (PoI), the new Stinker zombie, and the energy system! And that's not all!

We're constantly working on improving our game, but we need you – our community! Based on your feedback, we'll do our best to implement updates and improvements to the Survival Machine demo to ensure a smooth experience for everyone. If any issues arise, we’ll address them as quickly as possible – so keep an eye on Steam for new updates based on your input!

[h3]What awaits you?[/h3]

👉[b]Four-player co-op[/b] – This is what you’ve been waiting for, and it’s the star of our demo! While you can absolutely play solo, we highly encourage you to experience Survival Machine in four-player co-op. It’s up to you how you divide tasks and handle both the Machine and our friendly neighborhood zombies.

👉[b]Sixteen languages[/b] - play the latest Survival Machine demo in one of 16 available languages! You’ll find the full list in our previous post announcing today’s demo! Since the demo was translated using machine learning, there might be some minor issues. Feel free to let us know if you spot anything that needs adjusting and we fix it for the early access release!

👉[b]Ten different characters to choose from[/b] – We’ve prepared five male and five female characters for you. I'm sure everyone will find a character they'll enjoy spending time with in Survival Machine!

👉[b]Eight Points of Interest (PoIs)[/b] – Three large and five smaller Points of Interest are waiting for you to explore. Some will challenge you to fight off hordes of zombies, others will test your wits with puzzles, and some will push your agility and reflexes to the limit!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/feb941adcc5ea935251d012e27977d4a211ff1ea.png[/img]

👉[b]Three enemy types[/b] – If you played the previous demo, you’re already familiar with regular zombies and armored zombies. In this alpha, you’ll encounter a new one – the Stinker. This foe deals area damage with its toxic gas, so be careful when getting too close!

👉[b]Energy System[/b] – We've introduced this feature to add more depth to managing the Machine and keeping its systems running smoothly. Machine components wear out over time, and you'll need fuel to power key structures. Make sure to keep an eye on fuel levels—without it, defending the Machine during the night invasion will be much more challenging!

👉[b]Total time freedom[/b] – That’s right! Many of you pointed this out in your feedback on the previous demo. This time, there’s no need to worry about time limits—the restriction has been removed. Now, you can dive into Survival Machine and play at your own pace, however you like!

👉[b]The Frontier[/b] -  the first biome, is available to you to play and explore! You will be able to explore one third of the first biome. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/67687c0cf6c2afea5d31ef5d712819f5f6f2c728.png[/img]

👉[b]Character upgrades[/b] - you will have access to several character upgrades to enhance your gameplay experience like zipline, increased health ugrade and expanded backpack to carry more resources. Increase vehicle functionality and add extra buffs thanks to Machine's upgrades. 

👉[b]Defensive structure[/b] - defensive structures such as bomb thrower will help you fight zombie night attacks. But remember to fuel the Machine!

👉[b]Base building[/b] - walls, stairs, storage extensions and decorations and many many more are waiting for you! 

👉[b]Craft items[/b] - You can build various crafting and resource processing structures to enhance your capabilities and upgrade your character. You have access to several items that you can craft anywhere in the world without the need for a specialised crafting table. Items like clubs, slings, hammers and axes will come very handy!

[h3]Something extra![/h3]

In addition, we’ve got a little contest and one more surprise in store for you! Keep an eye on our Discord and Steam, and you’ll find out all the details!

[h3]Feedback - if you have one share one![/h3]

[b]Your opinion is very important to us.[/b] By leaving comments here on Steam or [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]on our Discord[/url], you've had a real impact on the development of the game. Many of your suggestions have been implemented, and we’re still working on others. We read and analyze all feedback carefully—there are no opinions that are unimportant to us. That’s why we kindly ask you to share your thoughts with us as widely as possible.

One of the preferred ways to share your feedback is to use our form. [url=https://forms.gle/thRNdSajpFZt4JZ4A]Here it is![/url]

[b]And most importantly – if you enjoyed our demo, please leave us a review on Steam.[/b] It’s a very important indicator for us of how you perceive our game and whether you’d recommend it to a friend for a co-op session! We’re counting on you!

That’s all I’ve prepared for you today. I hope you have a great time in Survival Machine! Watch out for those zombies—they might just eat you! See you next time!

notes.title: Coop - what to expect?
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/bbafb51533b277aac73e2b7442f3aff67850d071.jpg[/img]
[h1]Coop - What Will It Be Like, and What Can You Expect?[/h1]

In today’s devlog, I’d like to share more details about the cooperative gameplay in both the early access version of Survival Machine and the later stages of development. Many of you have been asking about co-op on our Discord (if you haven’t joined yet, we encourage you to do so—there’s a link at the bottom of the page). 

I thought this would be a great opportunity to give you a dedicated space to ask questions and leave suggestions. Your feedback has been invaluable during the closed alpha and demo phases, and we’re eager to hear your thoughts on co-op as well.

[h3]The Basics: How Will It Work?[/h3]

In Survival Machine, you can enjoy the game solo, but for those who love playing with friends, we’re designing a cooperative mode for up to four players.

To keep things simple and player-driven, we’re using a peer-to-peer system instead of external servers. This means the host’s computer will manage the session.

Key Detail: At this time, we’re not planning to allow random matchmaking with strangers. You won’t be able to search for games with open slots and join them. Instead, we believe Survival Machine works best with an invite system, where players can choose who they want to play with.

To start a co-op session, you’ll invite your friends via our lobby—easy! The host generates a unique code in the game and shares it with their friends to join.

[h3]Saving the Game[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/45201ea1cd6d1bf7ef7867f736144c3ae3ad3cf1.jpg[/img]
Each player in a session can save progress using the book located on the Machine. However, [b]the save file is only stored on the host’s Machine[/b]. This means that if you wrap up a session and want to return later, only the host can load the saved world.

[h3]What Makes you stand out?[/h3]
Personalization! When joining a game, players can select one of several pre-designed characters, available in both male and female options. We’re working hard to offer a wide variety of distinctive designs so everyone can feel at home in their survival avatar.

[h3]Task Sharing[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/11d8b993b630f53d0ca6bcaa1c5999e2ad0761f9.jpg[/img]
In Survival Machine, players share one overarching goal: to reach the last bastion of humanity in a world overrun by zombies. But how you accomplish that is entirely up to you.

While completing story quests is a central part of the game, you’ll also need to manage tasks like maintaining the Machine, exploring, crafting, and gathering resources.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/dc805dbb12afc8522797a867f93af9cabe077d42.jpg[/img]
We’re leaving these decisions in your hands. You can choose to split tasks among your team or tackle everything together. For example, if one player loves crafting and another prefers tackling challenges at points of interest, that’s fine—there’s something for everyone!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/94ffc3dfd6113fa44c3fa7d1a5d76ccda6f8c50c.jpg[/img]
[h3]Balancing the Game[/h3]
Balancing has been one of our main challenges. We want you to feel appropriately challenged, whether playing solo or with up to three friends. Based on your feedback from the demo, we know solo play can feel a bit overwhelming. Here’s how we’re addressing it:

Solo Play Adjustments:
[list][*] Fewer zombies to fight.
[*] Nighttime attacks will be less intense.
[*] Operating the Machine will require less fuel to move and power workstations.[/list]
Co-op Adjustments:
[list][*] The game will adapt to the combined levels of all players rather than matching the highest-level player.[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/2edc27ba2cc2792b2f4ad066ca5c73452bfb1603.jpg[/img]
[h3]Inventory[/h3]
Each player will have their own personal inventory for items like melee weapons, shields, resources, tools, and powerful black powder firearms.

On the Machine, you’ll have shared storage. If you run out of space, you can build additional barrels or shelves to expand storage capacity. The shared inventory ensures everyone in the team has access to resources. Pretty neat, right?

[h1]Wrap up![/h1]
That's all for today! We hope you have an amazing time with our co-op mode! If you have any questions, feel free to drop them in the comments section here on Steam. For those interested, [url=https://discord.gg/wZtvm9SqD8]join us on Discord[/url]! See you there! 👋
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1601330/Survival_Machine/]Dont forget to add us to your wishlist![/url]
Dzięki! 
Berdol

[h1]1. Intro[/h1]

[u][b]Hello Survivors![/b][/u] 

We're excited to share that we're kicking off development logs to keep you in the loop about our progress. We know it's been a while since we communicated with you. We want to apologise for that and what’s more important: we want to change that. Expect to find details about what's coming up, content updates, progress GIFs, photos, and sneak peeks into our (not-so) future plans. Stay tuned for some insights into our development journey!
[h1]2. Our path until today[/h1]

To help us get funding, we have created a trailer to showcase our vision. Its success helped us find a publisher, secure funding, and start the initial development phase [i](I was there Gandalf…[/i]). That was a big thing for us as we could concentrate on what we really wanted to do - a fun game we all could enjoy. 
We were filled with joy and a sense of purpose. Unfortunately, after the pre-production, the publisher had to step back due to industry crises. As you can imagine that was a huge blow and step-back for us and we were very close to wrapping the whole thing up.

However! Thanks to the funding we acquired later, we're now in a solid position to persist with development and actively seek out a new partner for our project.	

[h1]3. What to expect from Survival Machine?[/h1]

We know what game we want to build. We're excited to start sharing our game concept with you! We want to highlight the game’s mood, style and features that define Survival Machine. Here are some of the pillars of our gameplay:
[list][*]We’re creating a[b] [u]lighthearted survival-adventure game[/u][/b] centred around exploration and fighting zombies
[*]The game is about the journey of the machine and you alongside it
[*]At its essence, the game has been made to deliver a fun experience, especially when played with friends (up to 4 players)
[*]There are multiple playstyles available, in combat and in gathering resources
[*]Approach it with a good sense of humour—it's designed to be enjoyed with a wink and not taking itself too seriously.[/list][h1]4. Features[/h1]

Consider this as our first iteration—just a little peek into the evolving world of Survival Machine we're creating. Although the game development has been ongoing for over a year now, not everything is set in stone. 
We acknowledge the possibility that not all of our ideas will work in the game, and we would greatly appreciate hearing some feedback from you, because you and your feedback and insights will play a crucial role in shaping the subsequent versions of the game. 
Get ready to witness (and help with) the transformation as we work very hard to enhance and refine Survival Machine!			
[h2]4.1 Machine concept[/h2]

Here you get a sneak peek at the initial machine concept, it has changed a lot and we will reveal the whole machine in the future! Follow our journey to be among the first to see the final model working in the game :)		

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/55169250b1c3eb823d405c9ae804b256f70b88b9.png[/img]
[h2]4.2 Melee combat[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/6f8e660bee7ad16b5b15b37d2ec06d8b2f44cbea.gif[/img]

As you well know yourself, no self-respecting survival game can do without hand-to-hand combat (especially when it has zombies in it). The same applies to the Survival Machine of course. In our game, you will find various types of melee weapons, ranging from pickaxes and axes primarily used for resource gathering (though they can be used for combat as a last resort), to classic melee weapons such as clubs or swords. But wait, there’s more!
[h3]1. We have a few features that work well here:	[/h3]
[list]
[*] Weapons have different combo lengths and special attacks
[*] Players can kick zombies and they fall from the machine (or other ledges, believe us - it's fun!)[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/7d35373faf554fbc3759bcd23bce09220f20b631.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Player can block enemy attacks
[*] Shields have a block rate shown by a number of shields on the screen[/list][h3]2. Next steps are to:[/h3][list]
[*] implement new zombie hit reactions (check the next section for some visuals)
[*] implementing a perfect block that will stun a zombie
[*] adding critical chances for special weapons
[*] general polish of animations and our zombie behaviour[/list][h2]4.3 New Hit Reactions for Zombies[/h2]

⠀⠀       [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/e9c98c8f2b4ca2bb54556cfedb099a06749e80ba.gif[/img]

Although it's currently a visual concept, its cool aesthetics will soon come to life in the game. The implementation phase is just around the corner!

[h2]4.4 Artillery[/h2]

What will you be shooting from?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/6617a3aac8db76f3d1a634bd76997b7a09812a72.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] cannon - a cannon is a formidable artillery piece characterised by its large calibre and the ability to launch projectiles over substantial distances
[*] light cannon - a light cannon is a compact artillery piece characterised by its relatively smaller calibre and lightweight design.	
[*] mortar - mortars are typically used for indirect fire, with the projectiles arcing high into the air before descending onto the target. They are known for their versatility.
[*] scorpio - just as effective as in Roman times. Especially formidable at medium distances.
[*] ballista - On the battlefield, ballista plays a role in providing ranged support and harassing zombies[/list]
We've also added a special mechanic that allows for faster reloading. If you manage to press the action button at the right moment, you'll significantly increase your rate of fire: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40709796/ef924fa6a8a1b9766a908889273535016d144e38.gif[/img]
